name: AbortOnTerminate
evidence: the default terminate hook D_00278048: calls AbortProgram

name: RunTerminateHook
evidence: calls the function the terminate hook D_00278048 holds (the exception runtime and HandleAbstractCall call it)

name: MatchTypeNameOrZero
evidence: compares a type's name with a given one through CompareStrings: returns its third argument when they are equal, 0 otherwise (throw.c; it sits in the exception runtime's unwind table with no direct caller)

name: AllocateRuntimeNode
evidence: allocates a 0x18-byte node under the runtime lock, terminates when that fails, zeroes it and points its field at +4 to its own +0x10 (throw.c)

name: GetExceptionContext
evidence: returns the exception context by calling the getter in D_0027804C (throw.c)

name: GetActiveExceptionSlot
evidence: returns the address of the active exception pointer, at +8 of the exception context (throw.c; the exception entry points read it)

name: InstallExceptionContextGetter
evidence: first call of D_0027804C: replaces it with GetStaticExceptionContext and calls that (throw.c)

name: GetStaticExceptionContext
evidence: returns the single static exception context, zeroing it and giving it a handler buffer on first use (throw.c; the runtime has one thread)

name: GetHandlerChainSlot
evidence: returns the address of the handler chain head, at +4 of the exception context (throw.c)

name: ThrowToTopHandler
evidence: runs the cleanups registered in the top exception handler, then jumps to that handler

name: PopHandlerAndThrow
evidence: pops the top exception handler after running its cleanups, then throws again

name: ActiveExceptionMatches
evidence: asks the active exception's type information to match a given type through its matcher and returns whether it did (throw.c)

name: GetRecordSubkind
evidence: reads the halfword at +6 of an exception record (throw.c; PushThrownException stores 1 there)

name: GetRecordKind
evidence: reads the halfword at +4 of an exception record (throw.c; PushThrownException stores 4 there and the matcher tests for it)

name: FindInnermostRangeValue
evidence: looks a code address up in a table of (low, high, value) ranges ended by 0xFFFFFFFF and returns the value of the narrowest range holding it, else 0 (throw.c; FindHandlerAndRestoreRegisters calls it)

name: FindHandlerInSpanTable
evidence: walks a table of code spans with handler callbacks, asks each matching span's callback whether it takes the exception, and returns the span's value, flagging cleanup-only matches (throw.c)

name: ResolveSavedRegisterSlot
evidence: follows a register's redirections in an unwind state until it reaches a saved register, and returns its storage; aborts when it was not saved (throw.c)

name: CopySavedRegister
evidence: copies one saved register (4, 8 or 16 bytes by its number) from one unwind state's storage to another's (throw.c)

name: UnwindOneFrame
evidence: finds the unwind state of a code address, then works out the frame's own address from the caller's state and the frame's offset (throw.c; the handler search calls it for each frame)

name: NoteCleanupOnlyHandler
evidence: empty hook that the handler search calls when it ends on a cleanup-only handler (throw.c)

name: FindHandlerAndRestoreRegisters
evidence: walks frames outwards from a code address until a handler takes the exception, then unwinds the saved registers up to that frame; terminates when there is none (throw.c; the throw and rethrow entries call it)

name: RethrowActiveException
evidence: rethrows the active exception: finds the caller's unwind state, searches for a handler and returns into it with the stack adjusted; terminates when nothing is active (throw.c; the same routine the compiler's rethrow calls)

name: ThrowException
evidence: the same as RethrowActiveException after recording in the context the index the thrower passes (throw.c; the compiler's throw calls it)
